data.name: Jagatguru
data.gender_notes: Jagatguru is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jagatguru is a title given to a spiritual master who is considered to be the teacher of the world. It is derived from two Sanskrit words: 'jagat' meaning 'world' and 'guru' meaning 'teacher'. This title is given to those who have attained a high level of spiritual knowledge and are capable of guiding others towards the path of enlightenment.
data.spiritual_meaning: A beacon of wisdom and knowledge, leading the way for others towards spiritual growth.
data.etymology: Jagatguru belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Teacher of the World.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jagatguru total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The title Jagatguru carries a great cultural significance in India, where the guru-shishya parampara (lineage of the spiritual master and disciple) has played a vital role in the spiritual, social, and intellectual development of Indian society. Jagatgurus are revered and respected figures in the Hindu community, and their teachings have influenced generations of seekers in the quest for self-realization and inner peace. The title infuses a sense of pride and honor, not just for the Jagatguru himself but also for his followers and the broader Hindu community.
data.spiritual_significance: The title Jagatguru signifies the spiritual master's deep understanding of the universe and its intricate workings. He is considered to be a bridge between the divine and the mundane, and his teachings provide guidance on the path to self-realization and ultimate liberation. The title provides a sense of connection to the divine, inspiring devotion, reverence, and a deep sense of humility that transcends worldly concerns. In essence, Jagatguru embodies the wisdom, compassion, and grace of the divine, offering guidance and solace to seekers on their spiritual journey.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Jagatguru signifies a spiritual master who illuminates the entire world (jagat) with the light of knowledge (guru). I. Jagatguru represents a spiritual guide who enlightens the entire universe with the radiance of wisdom. II. The title "Jagatguru" signifies a guru whose teachings illuminate and transform the entire cosmos.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Jagatguru is a title given to revered spiritual leaders in Hinduism. The name Jagatguru carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Jagatguru was a title given to spiritual leaders who were considered to be the spiritual guides of the world (jagat).

modern_usage.modern_context: In modern times, the term Jagatguru is used to refer to revered spiritual leaders in Hinduism who are considered to be the spiritual guides of the world. The title is often given to heads of major Hindu monasteries and spiritual institutions.
